title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.30583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, all

translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体相对于受信任监控器的智能水平不断提升，监控器无法理解智能体行为或无法自信评估这些行为的风险也随之增加。我们将审讯协议引入高风险的AI控制场景，允许监控器向不受信任的智能体就令人困惑的行为提出问题。要让审讯真正提升安全性，较弱的模型必须能够区分攻击策略产生的误导性解释与诚实策略产生的真实解释。我们发现在BashArena的留出测试子集上，一个审讯协议在1%审计预算下将安全性从仅基于行为的基线的72.6%提升至79.5%（+7.0个百分点 [+0.9, +20.1]，95%配对自助法置信区间），但这一提升的大部分可以通过让受信任的模型陈述一个具体担忧来获得。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，审讯智能体可以提升安全性……
tldr: 本文提出在AI控制中引入审讯协议，让受信任的监控器通过向不受信任的智能体提问来辨别其行为解释的真伪，在BashArena基准上将1%审计预算下的安全性从72.6%提升至79.5%，但大部分提升仅靠受信任模型陈述具体担忧即可获得。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces interrogation protocols for AI control, enabling trusted monitors to question untrusted agents about confusing actions, improving safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% to 79.5% on BashArena, though most of the uplift can be captured by simply having the trusted model state a specific concern.
